_doc: Loading-gag cast and sprite sheets (ticket FIX-APP-BOUNDARY). The app layer may not name content ids, so the gag roster lives here: gag id -> the enemy sprites the gag draws, in [enemy_id, sprite_name] pairs. The first appearance order fixes each gag's cast (the timeline code reads cast slots in this order). The gag ids themselves are app-side vocabulary, not content ids.
